module edge_detect(
    input clk, 
    input rst_n, 
    input a,
    output rise, 
    output down
);
// Sequential logic block
reg [1:0] a_reg;
always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        a_reg <= 2'b00; // Initialize register to 00 on reset
    end else begin
        a_reg <= {a_reg[0], a}; // Shift register to store previous value of 'a'
    end
end
// Combinational logic for edge detection
assign rise = (a_reg == 2'b01); // Rising edge detected
assign down = (a_reg == 2'b10); // Falling edge detected
endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="edge_detect">
    <description>Edge detector for detecting rising and falling edges of a slow-changing 1-bit signal 'a'.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="a">Input signal.</input>
        <output id="rise">Output signal indicating a rising edge.</output>
        <output id="down">Output signal indicating a falling edge.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <!-- Define any necessary parameters here if needed -->
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        // Sequential logic block
        reg [1:0] a_reg;
        
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                a_reg <= 2'b00; // Initialize register to 00 on reset
            end else begin
                a_reg <= {a_reg[0], a}; // Shift register to store previous value of 'a'
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic for edge detection
        assign rise = (a_reg == 2'b01); // Rising edge detected
        assign down = (a_reg == 2'b10); // Falling edge detected
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Detailed behavior of the edge detect module
        // Detects rising and falling edges of the input signal 'a'
        // Rise is set to 1 when a transitions from 0 to 1
        // Down is set to 1 when a transitions from 1 to 0
        // Both rise and down are set to 0 otherwise
    </implementation>
</module>
